speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Two oaths, Master Shakespeare, and then I am done being troubled. By my holidame, in the clown's mouth. God's me, in the young man's. The Queen's ladies may hear God's name in church, Master Shakespeare. Elsewhere, 'by Jove' serves.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then those two come out. By Jove can stand where they stood. I will not spend the morning arguing a clown back into an oath.

speaker: (the tailor)
text: The sleeve is short by a hand's breadth. I will let it out before Sunday. The silver thread can wait on the other bench.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Let it out, and do not talk across a book. Sunday's wedding will have its cloth. It will not have a scene of mine, and it will not have one of yours unless someone has paid for it, which no one in this room has.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No one has paid for a wedding. We have paid, if you sign, for a comedy. Seven shillings. I have them here. They are the company's.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: I have not signed. Is there truly a King of Navarre in it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a king of that name. Only the name. It was in the air. I did not sit him on a throne I have seen.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: The air is a large place, and it is not a diplomatic pouch. The Spaniard's melancholy. I will leave it. It harms nobody, and it made me smile, which I do not intend to make a habit of before dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Armado may keep the melancholy. I am not decorating him for you.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: And the French lords. Does any of them glance at a living ambassador?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. None of them. They are lords in a comedy. They are not news.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Then I am reassured, which is the feeling I prefer to have when I sign. The two oaths are struck. Nothing else is struck. Give me the last leaf.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Seven shillings. I am counting them onto the table, where you can see the pile and the book in the same look. Not out of his coffer. His coffer is not open.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: I see seven shillings, and I see a signature. Take the book. I have a sleeve to think about, and it is already more interesting than a fifth act.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fifth act is where it was. Plain, not pleading. I am not mending it on your stair.

speaker: john_heminges
text: We have the signature. We are not giving a part away between here and Gracechurch Street. Abel copies. Abel does not copy today from my pocket.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Armado's melancholy may stay, as I said. I am not striking a joke because it is Spanish. I am striking God's name where the Queen's ladies are not in church. If I have been unclear, the pen has not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have been clear. Two oaths. Nothing else. I will not restore them in the tiring-house and call it custom.

speaker: (the tailor)
text: The hand's breadth is let out. The sleeve will do for Sunday. I am not asking the players whether a sleeve is a poem.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No one here thinks a sleeve is a poem. Seven shillings is the whole of our business on this table, and it is counted. We are going before the cloth gets into the book.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Then good day. By Jove is quite enough Jove for one morning. Shut the door as you go. The cloth raises a dust.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good day. The refusal in the fifth act stays plain. I am not pleading it at you on the way out.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Plead it to a yard, if you must plead. I have signed. The yard is not my household. Sunday is.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Sunday is his. The book is ours again, with his name on the last leaf. That is the errand. We are done standing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Done standing. The two oaths stay out. I am not putting them back in the yard to feel braver.
